book.noclip_backrooms.manila_guide.page1:
To whoever is reading this:

We are the Manila Mary Foundation, and we are here to help. Please take any food or Almond Water from the cabinet below and rest.

You have made it through the hardest part.
book.noclip_backrooms.manila_guide.page2:
This place is Level 0 of the Backrooms. Outside these tan walls, the halls shift when no one is watching.

Inside the Manila Room, the humming fades, the walls stay still, and wanderers can meet safely.
book.noclip_backrooms.manila_guide.page3:
The cabinet below holds supplies to keep you going.

Watch the yellow walls nearby: when a wall begins to flicker and crackle, step through to reach Level 1.

- In memory of Manila Mary

book.noclip_backrooms.field_note.0.page1:
Shift Note - Upper Breaker Lofts

Whoever built the wiring above Level 0 hid secondary breaker panels inside the stair lofts above ceiling height.
book.noclip_backrooms.field_note.0.page2:
Throwing the wall lever in a Utility Loft pushes voltage down through the sub-grid and brings nearby dead fluorescent lamps back online.

Leave the cabinet supplies for the next shift.
book.noclip_backrooms.field_note.1.page1:
Observation Post - Above Ceiling Y=36

I stayed upstairs for six hours watching the yellow halls through the smoked floor panes. Nobody passed below, yet footsteps kept pacing in the next crawlspace.
book.noclip_backrooms.field_note.1.page2: Some stairwells aren't dead ends at all - look for crawlspace bridges over the lights or concrete stairs dropping below the damp carpet.
book.noclip_backrooms.field_note.2.page1:
Maintenance & Seal Log

Water has been seeping into the lower service basements beneath several corridors. Pipes up top never stay dry for long.
book.noclip_backrooms.field_note.2.page2: Warning regarding upper red-lit landings: one door was framed where no room ever existed behind it. Only black Void Stone sits beyond the latch.

message.noclip_backrooms.clipp:
C.L.I.P.P. protocol (Ariane Circle, Hermes team):
C - Check your environment for threats and the structure around you.
L - Locate an exit: a noclip back out, or a door, window or other threshold.
I - Inspect the database to work out which level this is and which exit is safe.
P - Prepare your equipment, and change clothes if you need to.
P - Perimeter your environment: make a temporary safe zone.

message.noclip_backrooms.level0p1.rhea.0: [Notes] Einstein-Rosen bridge, run 41: the field holds. Countdown set. If this works, nobody will ever be far from anywhere again.

message.noclip_backrooms.level0p1.rhea.2: [Notes] The bridge did not open where we aimed it. It opened under us. I could see the station from outside, and then I could not.
message.noclip_backrooms.level0p1.rhea.3: [Notes] Nobody answers. The corridors are yellow now, and I keep walking them. I am only going to sit down for a moment.
